build_directories: separate before and after targets from git-archive exports of each commit
measurement_order: before/after then after/before at each size; Nexus probes before then after
start_gate: runs started after builds finished, once the 1-minute load average fell below 6
limitations: No exclusive CPU isolation; window server and desktop processes used about 1.5 cores.
The Nexus probe checks answers and Concept GETs over synthetic current rows; its process time is dominated by seeding and is not a query latency.
Neither harness exercises the SEARCH corpus or prepared-scope caches changed by 4afaef1.
